_README: Plain-language texts for the atlas cards, keyed by card id. English, like the whole repository, and written for a reader who is not an ML specialist: short sentences, everyday words, identifiers left as they are. Every entry carries the repository path it was written from; nothing here may say more than that source says. A card with no entry renders as a hatched 'not explained' block, so the debt stays visible. Card ids: where_we_are, flies, curves, penalised, board, night1..night5, diag:<id>, and a backlog entry NAME (with awaits_mike: true) to put that entry into “Awaiting Mike's word” when its own text does not contain the phrase.

backlog_plain._README: Board entries restated in plain language, keyed by entry name. `text` is what the entry records, in everyday words and without softening; `ask` is the decision being asked of Mike, put as a question he can answer in a word. The source is the entry itself in backlog.md — its envelope sentence and its “First step” item. An entry with no restatement here shows its own board sentence under a small hatch, so the debt stays visible.

THE-CHEAP-AND-THE-DEAR-ESTIMATE-ARE-TAKE._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close: the previous text said stop_iter was still undecided, and it is decided.
THE-CHEAP-AND-THE-DEAR-ESTIMATE-ARE-TAKE.text: The card changes name rather than closing. Its boundary half weakened: the penalised quantity passes smoothly through 150,000 in all ten runs, and held-out loss carries no step there either, so by the time the penalty was dropped it was no longer holding the network. Its other half stands and is now the live claim: at 25,000, where the cheap probe sits, that quantity is markedly higher and more variable in most runs, so the cheap probe is taken while the system is still unsettled. That is a statement about where the probe is placed, not about two regularisation regimes.
THE-CHEAP-AND-THE-DEAR-ESTIMATE-ARE-TAKE.ask: Decided, 2026-09-20: stop_iter is left untouched. What is left is not a run but a registration — which version of (b) is meant, the probe-placement question or the regularisation question — and it belongs in the blind v2 session.

THE-INSTRUMENTS-WERE-AUDITED-THE-DAY-THE.text: An audit of the diagnostic code found controls that cannot veto anything, constants that were never checked against the pre-registration, and an unwritten rule for how the null is drawn. Nineteen fixes are ready, each with a falsifier of its own.
THE-INSTRUMENTS-WERE-AUDITED-THE-DAY-THE.ask: Fix the instruments? You have already said “fix the instruments” — confirm it and level A goes ahead (items 1, 15, 16).

FLYVIS-RESUME-AND-RECOVER-ARE-BROKEN-IN-.text: Running the installed flyvis 1.2.0 turned up five defects which together make it impossible to resume an interrupted run. None of them has been reported to its developers.
FLYVIS-RESUME-AND-RECOVER-ARE-BROKEN-IN-.ask: Open an issue on flyvis/flyvis with a minimal 48-iteration reproduction? Until that happens the rule stands: an interrupted run counts as a failed run.

WINDOWS-UPDATE-RESTARTS-INSIDE-THE-NIGHT.text: A scheduled Windows Update restart killed seed 2 in mid-run: active hours end at 06:00, while the night window runs until 11:30. The launcher has no check for a pending restart.
WINDOWS-UPDATE-RESTARTS-INSIDE-THE-NIGHT.ask: How do we defend against it: pause updates before every night, move active hours to 02:00–11:30, or set a policy? Once you choose, a pre-flight check goes into start_night.ps1.

THE-TUNING-BATTERY-CHECKS-WHETHER-THE-DO.text: The tuning battery — every cell type's response to a flash and to a moving edge, checked against Maisak 2013 — would show whether R2 in seed 2, Mi4 in seed 3 and CT1 in seed 4 really are tuned differently from the same type in the other five runs.
THE-TUNING-BATTERY-CHECKS-WHETHER-THE-DO.ask: Run it? A subagent does the computing, Ark and Zcode read the brief before it starts, and readings (a)–(d) are fixed before any data exists.

THE-GENOME-DESIGN-AROUND-S2-NEEDS-LABEL-._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close: both prerequisites it asked for have been delivered, so the old text asked for work that is done.
THE-GENOME-DESIGN-AROUND-S2-NEEDS-LABEL-.text: Both prerequisites are delivered. CC's note on what a genome is here is in the repository; Ark's design around S2 is placed, and the label check ran in the form Ark revised after finding that his own input rule mixed two axes. Step 0 verified the design's field inventory against the flyvis source rather than against the brief it was relayed from. One thing blocks the extraction and it is small: Ark owes an amendment to his own section 4, which he has withdrawn.
THE-GENOME-DESIGN-AROUND-S2-NEEDS-LABEL-.ask: Nothing for you here unless Ark stalls. He amends section 4, then CC extracts the rule bank and the label array.

THE-LEARNED-GAIN-IS-SIXTY-LOSS-UNITS-ON-.text: Training buys about sixty loss units, against an untrained level of twelve hundred. Measured against that learned gain instead of against the raw loss, the difference between two repeats comes to 21 % and the spread between seeds to 6 % — a possible basis for the next registration.
THE-LEARNED-GAIN-IS-SIXTY-LOSS-UNITS-ON-.ask: In the next pre-registration, should the tolerance be a fraction of the learned gain instead of raw loss — does that replace the old form or sit beside it? Mike and the reviewers decide.

SIXTEEN-MEGABYTES-OF-UNARCHIVED-SCRATCHP.text: Sixteen megabytes are left in the scratch folder of a session that has ended: pre-registration drafts, chat exports, PDFs and a lora-work directory. They will not go anywhere by themselves, and nobody maintains them.
SIXTEEN-MEGABYTES-OF-UNARCHIVED-SCRATCHP.ask: What happens to them: into connectome-seed-archive/, or deleted?

NON-DETERMINISM-IN-TRAINING-MAY-BE-THE-S._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close: the short check the old text asked for has been run, so its question is answered and the entry's remaining question is a different one.
NON-DETERMINISM-IN-TRAINING-MAY-BE-THE-S.text: No longer a candidate — the source is established. Replicates of one seed are copies of one config to the last field: identical at iteration 0, apart by under one float32 step at iteration 12, apart by the whole gap at the end. Since replicates share the bias draw, the decoder's initial weights and the data order, the gap can only come from something that varies inside one fixed seed, and that is the order of GPU operations in training. The short check you would have been asked for is done: deterministic training costs about three and a third times more, no operator refuses, and the same seed twice is bitwise identical over two thousand iterations. What remains is a different question — whether an individual exists at all — and more determinism does not answer it, because under determinism there are no replicates to spread.
NON-DETERMINISM-IN-TRAINING-MAY-BE-THE-S.ask: Answered on 2026-09-20 in both directions: the control is done, and you said not to spend the night. The open question moved to the perturbation ladder, which is its own card.

THE-PERTURBATION-LADDER-MEASURES-HOW-FAS.text: Proposed in place of the night that was not launched, and not authorised. Under deterministic training the night has an exact zero of its own, so anything that moves is the perturbation and nothing else. One seed, one parameter nudged by a controlled amount, stepped from the smallest float32 step up to the full difference between two different seeds — on an edge parameter, not on the cell-type biases, because the activity penalty pushes the biases back for the first 150,000 iterations and the ladder would end up measuring the penalty. Read by shape, which is where the profiles pointed. What it measures is how far an individual can be pushed and still read as itself. The night that was authorised could not have measured it: under determinism the replicate spread is undefined, not zero, so there is nothing to compare against.
THE-PERTURBATION-LADDER-MEASURES-HOW-FAS.ask: Run the ladder, yes or no? On yes the reading rule is written, reviewed and registered before a single rung runs; the cost is set by the number of rungs and is far below a night. On no, whether an individual exists stays answered only descriptively, from checkpoints already on disk.

ROWB-PY-CANNOT-ADDRESS-A-FUTURE-NIGHTS-R.text: The profile instrument picks what to read by night number, so any night after night 5 needs either a script change or a second script. The cheap fix is one additive switch that takes the run-to-column mapping as a file — which also cures, for this instrument, the standing defect that a run's correspondence to its column keeps being derived from a name instead of written down. Additive means existing invocations produce byte-identical output, proved by re-running a committed dry run and diffing the bytes.
ROWB-PY-CANNOT-ADDRESS-A-FUTURE-NIGHTS-R.ask: Add --run-columns to rowB.py, yes or no? On no, every future night writes its own mapping again and the correspondence defect gets its fourth instance.

THE-SPREAD-REPLICATE-RATIO-INVERTS-BETWE.text: At the top rung, 250,000, the spread between seeds is smaller than the difference between two repeats of one seed; at the C3 rung it is the other way round, larger. So the fork in §3 of the plan — the top rung is measurable, or it is not — can now be settled by these numbers.
THE-SPREAD-REPLICATE-RATIO-INVERTS-BETWE.ask: Which branch of §3 do we take? Mike and the reviewers decide.

THE-COMPOSITION-MARGIN-OVER-ITS-FLOOR-IS.text: The registered splice (a) reads as “composition is predictable”, with a margin of 0.40 over the floor — but that floor was borrowed from the difference between two repeats. Meanwhile a random shift of the same size moves the loss further than the splice does, and the splice run backwards blows up.
THE-COMPOSITION-MARGIN-OVER-ITS-FLOOR-IS.ask: How do we read the result: the rule stands as written; or it is re-read as uninformative, on the calibration; or the floor is registered afresh from the operation's own null distribution?

THE-REPLICATE-DIFFERS-BY-ONE-POINT-ONE-P.text: Seed 0, trained twice, comes apart by 1.11 % of held-out loss at iteration 250,000 — more than the 1 % tolerance written into that same file.
THE-REPLICATE-DIFFERS-BY-ONE-POINT-ONE-P.ask: Do we go on as registered, in which case the top rung may simply turn out to be unmeasurable, or do we write a new pre-registration of the expensive metric before the N runs start?

where_we_are._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close. The previous text stopped before three things the day produced: the profiles reading, the stop_iter decision, and night 6 being prepared and not launched. The superseded text is in git history at commit b9c86c6.
where_we_are.text: The goal is not to emulate a fly but to learn to make an elephant out of one: the five points of idea.md (Mike Shevchenko, 2026-09-12), whose main artefact is an evolutionary tree and not a video. The grammar is the main line — ADR-004, accepted 2026-09-20 — meaning a rule that generates the wiring. Measuring the fly is that line's instrument and runs beside it: point 4 of the idea is the cheap-and-dear pair, and a tree selected by an instrument that cannot tell two individuals apart would be a tree of noise. What the instrument says today: the condition turned out harder than it was written and is not settled in either direction. The dear side does not itself rank — two runs of the same individual come apart at least as far as six different individuals do. The question was also underspecified, and one half of that has now weakened: the penalised quantity was read across all 72 checkpoints and passes smoothly through the 150,000 boundary in every one of the ten runs, with no step in the loss there either, so by the time the penalty was lifted it was no longer holding the network. On that reading you decided to leave stop_iter untouched. What survives is narrower and still open: at 25,000, where the cheap probe sits, that quantity is higher and more variable in most runs — the probe is taken before the system has settled. Two further things landed the same day. The replicate gap is made entirely inside training, and its mechanism is ours: the order of GPU operations, the same thing that makes a single evaluation non-repeatable. And an individual does show somewhere — in the rank shape of its 65-type profile, not in its magnitude and not in held-out loss; the declared answer was MIXED and is reported as MIXED, with a reviewer's narrowing recorded beside it and neither reading chosen. Night 6 is prepared and was not launched, because under determinism there are no replicates to spread and the night would have had nothing to compare with; a perturbation ladder is proposed in its place and is not authorised.

night1.text: The first individual and its repeat: a point of reference, and the first measure of how noisy the instrument is. The tolerance on the repeat at 250,000 iterations was not met — and that became the night's main finding.

night2.text: Seeds 1 and 2. The first attempt at seed 2 was killed by a Windows Update restart in mid-run and redone as a wave of its own: an interrupted run counts as failed, and resuming is not used.

night3.text: Seeds 3 and 4 — the count of individuals reached five, and for the first time six final states could be compared with each other by the diagnostics.

night4.text: A repeat of seed 3 and a sixth seed: a second pair of twins, and a sixth individual. From here on, instrument noise rests on two independent pairs rather than one.

night5.text: Third runs of individuals 0 and 3. What they bought is degrees of freedom: the estimate of repeat noise grew from 2 to 4 df, and the ratio of spread between individuals to the difference between repeats moved from 0.734 to 0.889 on the same evaluator. It is still below one, and the confidence intervals overlap almost entirely, so the answer did not change — what changed is how much it rests on.

flies.text: Six individuals, ten runs. Individuals 0 and 3 were run three times each, the rest once; a repeat is the same individual measured again, and repeats do not count towards N. N by individuals is six, and Row B may be read as a test only at N ≥ 8.

curves.text: Ten held-out loss curves, by checkpoint. The two vertical lines mark what made the question be reworded: up to 150,000 iterations flyvis penalises the activity of the 65 per-cell-type biases — the only parameters the seed moves — and after that it does not. The cheap probe C3 at 25,000 sits inside that regime; the top rung at 250,000 sits outside it. Which run belongs to which column is taken from an explicit table, not guessed from the column's name.

penalised._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close to record the owner's decision, which the old text could only say was not licensed yet.
penalised.text: Ark's free falsifier has run: the 150,000 boundary does not bind. In all ten runs the quantity's change across the boundary is smaller than — in one case of the same size as — its ordinary wandering from checkpoint to checkpoint nearby, and over the remaining iterations it moves in different directions in different runs. So the board's card about the cheap and the dear estimate living under different regularisation weakens; it weakens rather than closes, because this is an unregistered diagnostic at a coarse grid, and one run is left unclassified by the rule as written. It did not license changing stop_iter, and the decision went the other way on its own terms: Mike, 2026-09-20 — stop_iter is left untouched. What the reading leaves standing is the other half, that the cheap probe at 25,000 is taken while the system is still unsettled.

diag:rowB-night5._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close: the old text said the count grows as the run proceeds, and the run has finished.
diag:rowB-night5.text: The instrument runs the way the nights ran, with determinism off. Control P1-prime — the recording hook does not change the loss — fails in most pairs, and the cause is not the hook: two identical computations of one state take different operation orders on the GPU and so do not agree bit for bit. An absolute tolerance of 1e-6 is unreachable on that path by construction. The tolerance was not amended and the FAIL verdicts stand as a result. The full run over all ten runs and 72 checkpoints has finished, so the counts on this tile are final rather than growing; the same three checkpoints counted inside the full run and in the separate short run disagree, which is itself the point — in this mode the count is not a stable number.

diag:rowB-night5-det._note: Rewritten 2026-09-20 at the session close: the old text said the full run was in progress, and it has finished.
diag:rowB-night5-det.text: The same instrument with determinism on — a separate instrument, writing its own files with a _det suffix, and the two modes are never pooled. Switching determinism on drives both differences, with the hook and without it, to exactly zero: the whole failure of repeatability in the normal mode was the order of GPU operations. The full run has finished and this mode is the record, because it recomputes to the bit; P1-prime passes as registered, with its tolerance never amended, and no operator refused determinism.

diag:reachability.text: The registered reachability endpoint was read exactly once and returned TEST UNREADABLE: the instrument's own resolution threshold removed 16 of the grid's 23 levels, and every one of them on the twins' side. This is neither a failure nor a success — the instrument reported that it cannot read. In this form the test is closed and will not be read again: a rule chosen after the numbers are visible is a rule fitted to them.

diag:ablation-night3.text: Cell-type ablation over six final states. By the rule written down before the reading, the verdict is positive for both new seeds: each one depends on a single type above the threshold. The twin trap holds on the 1−ρ measure — the pair (0, 0′) is still the global minimum out of 15 pairs — but on the Euclidean measure it no longer holds. None of this reads as a test: six final states of one configuration on one held-out set.

diag:rowB-night3.text: Row B over six individuals: the twin pair (0, 0′) is still the smallest of the 15 pairs, and the smallest in each of the 16 items taken separately, but its margin over the nearest unrelated pair fell from 0.1968 to 0.0556. A preview, not a test: at N = 6 the critical ρ is 0.90–1.00, and Row B may be read as a test only from N ≥ 8.

diag:gray.text: A gray stimulus takes away at least 90 % of the learned gain in all six seeds — with no picture to look at, the network is barely different from an untrained one. The side result matters more: neither the gray stimulus nor a zero input “blows up”, so the huge ablation deltas (+21,158 when R2 is clamped to zero, +30,626 when all of R1–R8 are) are measuring how fragile the dynamics are to being clamped to zero — an artefact of the instrument, not a dependence on vision — and the wording of the R2 finding ought to be rewritten.

diag:ablation-night2.text: The first run of cell-type ablation, over four final states: the instrument clamps one type's activity to zero and watches how far the loss rises. The gray-stimulus control later showed that this instrument's large numbers are to be read as fragility of the dynamics to being clamped to zero, not as a dependence on vision.

diag:rowB-night2.text: The first Row B: activity profiles over 65 cell types, taken from saved checkpoints, four individuals. A preview and not a test — at N = 4 the critical ρ is 0.90–1.00, and no number from this folder reads as a result of a registered experiment, today or later.

diag:c3.text: C3 measured two things: how much the trajectory jitters around 25,000 iterations, and what the evaluator's own floor is. Two different evaluation paths over one and the same state come apart by 1e-6 to 1e-5 loss units, while the difference between the hook at 25,000 and the checkpoint at 25,212 is 0.1411 — so that difference is almost entirely real movement of the training, and not a difference between the paths.

diag:dropk.text: A check of how well the ordering of three seeds survives dropping items from the held-out set. The full ordering over 16 items is 1 < 2 < 0. Drop one item and the ordering survives in 81 % of the subsets; drop three and only in 51 %. Drop a whole scene, and two of the six scenes turn the ordering over. The sign of the difference inside the twin pair survives in every subset.

diag:window.text: The window integral, offered as a cheap statistic, was checked against the brief's own promotion criterion: not one window became a candidate. Condition (ii) fails for every window — a window's correlation with the hook at 250,000 (0.4857–0.7143) is lower than the single-point statistic's own (0.8857), however run 703 is handled.

board.text: The board is the list of what is known and not done. Priority and status live in the entry itself; no figure here is recomputed — all of them are read off the entries' envelopes.
